questions.text: What fields must the hospital application form collect (e.g. hospital name, registration/licence number, address, contact person, phone, email, bed count)? Which are mandatory?

Which government documents are accepted as proof of existence (e.g. Clinical Establishment registration certificate, municipal trade licence, GST certificate), how many are required, and what file types / maximum size are allowed?

Does the applicant create the Hospital Admin login as part of this application (self sign-up), or is the Hospital Admin account created later (e.g. by Super Admin on ratification)? The blueprint lists 'Sign up vs Sign in' without detail.

While on temporary approval (before Super Admin ratification), what can the hospital do - full onboarding steps (departments, packages, rate lists, branding) and live patient registration, or configuration only? And if Super Admin stops the service, what happens to data already entered?
questions.answer: There is no limit on what they can do, if admin stops the service nothing can be accessed.

questions.text: Is the '250k' initialization step (listed as part of onboarding in the blueprint, behaviour currently undefined) in scope for this requirement, or should it be handled by a separate requirement?
questions.answer: its in scope for this requirement

questions.text: Which application should the Work Item(s) belong to? This requirement needs both the web-ui (application form, post-submit page, Super Admin review queue) and the api (Tenant Provisioning, certificate upload, status lifecycle, 250k milestone). Options: (a) two Work Items, one per app; (b) a single Work Item under one app - if so, which?
questions.answer: all ui components go un to web-ui and apis to in to api

questions.text: What technology stack should the implementation plan target? The blueprint lists the backend runtime/language and the web framework as 'not yet specified' (e.g. Node/NestJS, Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI for the api; React, Angular, Vue for the web-ui).

Which service creates the Hospital Admin account during self sign-up? The blueprint says the Identity Service 'does not create users - user creation is Hospital Admin's job', but req.md FR-3 has the applicant create the Hospital Admin login themselves. Should Tenant Provisioning create it (calling Identity), or should Identity get a special sign-up path?
questions.answer: Its the identity service itself (it was wrongly worded)

questions.text: The blueprint specifies 'PostgreSQL (per tenant)'. Should a new hospital's tenant database (or schema) be provisioned immediately on application submission, since temporary approval gives full access at once? And is 'per tenant' a separate database, a separate schema in a shared database, or shared tables with a tenant_id column?
questions.answer: There are different levels of saas in certain licenses
